turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how are you doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing well, thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My front step is crumbling. Is that a concrete job or what?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sounds like it. Is it just the edges breaking off, or are there big chunks missing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got let go from my last job and I'm terrified they'll ask about it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a fear lots of people have. Would you rather bring it up yourself early on, or wait and answer only if they ask?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Guess what just— oh, this is so good, come here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, sorry Moshi, give me a sec.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So when's your driving test again?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Thursday. I can't sleep thinking about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You'll be fine. Is it the parallel parking that's worrying you?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: All of it, honestly. Mostly the roundabouts. I freeze.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Want to go out tomorrow evening and just do roundabouts for an hour?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Would you really? That would help so much.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course. I'll bring snacks for afterwards.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You can continue the episode without me, I've seen it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: No way, we're watching it together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done and dusted. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. We'd stopped on how to handle being let go. Which approach feels right?
